question: Does the kālī-ṣoḍhā form require worship and recitation in this case?
premises: The kālī-ṣoḍhā is presented as an alternative.
Worship and recitation are standard ritual acts.
The verse negates these acts for this alternative.
inference: Even in the kālī-ṣoḍhā form, worship and recitation are not required here.
uncertainties: kālī+ṣoḍhā may refer to a specific ritual formulation or mantra form.
plain_english: O goddess, in the kālī-ṣoḍhā as well, there is neither worship nor likewise recitation.
